assertions.assertion: The factory disables automatic key management via options.KeyManagement.Enabled = false
Uses AddDeveloperSigningCredential(persistKey: false) or equivalent static signing key
Registers test clients via AddInMemoryClients with at least one client credentials client
The test calls RequestClientCredentialsTokenAsync (from IdentityModel) against the in-process server
assertions.rationale: RequestClientCredentialsTokenAsync called on the factory's TestServer client.

assertions.assertion: Asserts that the token response is not an error and contains a non-empty AccessToken
assertions.rationale: Asserts token.IsError false and AccessToken not null/empty.
